name: Colossalcon Prime
blurb: Colossalcon's flagship event, a multi-day anime and cosplay convention at the Kalahari Resort in Sandusky, Ohio.

picks: Voice of Brock and James in Pokémon

editions.evidence: Homepage/news text: 'June 2nd - 6th, 2027' and 'Admission for Colossalcon Prime 2027 Now Available! September 29th, 2026'

notes: This is the flagship/original event, now branded 'Colossalcon Prime' on its own site (colossalconprime.com) to distinguish it from the sibling Texas/East/North/Virginia editions listed on the colossalcon.com portal — used colossalconprime.com as the official url. The All Guests page also shows a 'Guests Coming Soon' promo graphic, so more names are expected; only Dan Green and Eric Stuart are confirmed as of 2026-10-05. Verify-05 recheck (2026-10-05): confirmed current -- colossalconprime.com hosts dedicated 'Guest Announcement: Dan Green' and 'Guest Announcement: Eric Stuart' pages, and a fresh extraction still shows just these two under 'Voice Over Guests' alongside a 'Guests Coming Soon' tile for the rest.
